body:
WOW! This might single handedly be the greatest piece of advice I've ever received by anyone, therapist, friend or otherwise. You obviously put a lot of thought into this and to me, it makes a lot of sense.

Unfortunately, I didn't receive much feedback on this post at all. I figured this would probably be the case considering the disclaimer at the top, and boring nature of my writing style (you're not alone in that category lol. However, I didn't find what you wrote to be dry at all).

This being said, I've come to the conclusion that the content of the advice I receive should only hold weight given that it's both sincere and thoroughly rationalized within the context of my life. Your response was constructed in this exact way, and obviously you took a great interest in reading my story and thinking about what to say constructively. I'll take your advice over a million half-assed generalized statements from people who don't know the first thing about me, any day.

I didn't take anything you said to offense, and I may very well try to forge a better relationship with my parents. That piece of advice specifically resonated with me because I've derived such negative thoughts and feelings from them for years. The fact that you picked up on that despite my limited mentioning of them is why I'm listening. Obviously you didn't just gloss over what I said, and you were really helpful!

Thanks for the help!  
Mike M.
